aka.zh: 沪嘉浏高速公路（2001—2006 年）

tagline.en: The mainland's first expressway, opened in 1988 and the first to stop charging tolls
tagline.zh: 中国大陆第一条高速公路，1988 年通车，也是第一条取消收费的高速公路

start.en: The Hujia interchange on the Middle Ring Road, Shanghai

end.en: The former Jiading town toll station, Jiading
end.zh: 嘉定原嘉定城区收费站

en: The Hujia Expressway, Shanghai route S5, runs 18.65 km north-west from the Middle Ring Road to Jiading, the satellite town that was then a separate county. It is a short road with a long claim: it was the first expressway on the Chinese mainland to open throughout, in October 1988, and in 2012 the first to stop charging tolls.

It no longer behaves like the intercity road it was built as. Since 2012 it has been rebuilt as a six-lane urban expressway, and from 2025 its inner 9.6 km is being raised onto a viaduct with surface roads beneath, the design speed cut to 80 km/h.
zh: 沪嘉高速即上海市 S5 公路，自中环路向西北至嘉定，全长 18.65 公里；嘉定当时还是上海的一个卫星城县。这条路很短，名头却很大：1988 年 10 月，它成为中国大陆第一条全线通车的高速公路；2012 年，又成为第一条取消收费的高速公路。
如今它已不再像当初那条城际公路。2012 年起它按双向六车道城市快速路标准改造；2025 年起，靠市区的 9.6 公里又开始改建为高架，地面设辅道，设计车速降至每小时 80 公里。

en: It was designed for 120 km/h on a 26 m roadbed within a 45 m strip of land, four lanes, fully access-controlled, for 38,000 vehicles a day. The surface is mostly asphalt concrete, with some concrete. There are 51 structures totalling 3,318.45 m, about a fifth of the length; the carriageways cross on separate twin bridges, and the largest span, 40 m, is on the Wenzaobang bridge.

Because it was the first, it was also a test bed: the builders tried soft-ground treatment, fly-ash embankments, anti-skid asphalt, rubber-plate expansion joints, geotextiles and electronic traffic monitoring on it. Building it took 1,504.86 mu of land, moved 58,300 square metres of buildings and 140 km of pipes and cables, and used 1.366 million cubic metres of earth.
zh: 它按设计车速每小时 120 公里、路基宽 26 米、公路用地宽 45 米建造，双向四车道，全封闭、全立交，设计昼夜交通量 3.8 万辆。路面以沥青混凝土为主，部分为水泥混凝土。全线共有各类构筑物 51 座，总长 3318.45 米，约占全长五分之一；上下行分设两座独立桥梁，最大跨径 40 米，在蕰藻浜大桥。
作为第一条，它也是一块试验田：软土地基处理、粉煤灰填筑路堤、沥青防滑层、桥梁橡胶板伸缩缝、土工布和交通监控设施都在这里试用。工程共征地 1504.86 亩，动迁房屋 5.83 万平方米，迁移各类管线 140 公里，完成土方 136.6 万立方米。

en: After three years of study, the Shanghai construction and planning commissions approved the preliminary design on 14 December 1984, to expressway standard, and work began on 21 December. The road opened on 31 October 1988; Jiang Zemin, then Party secretary of Shanghai, cut the ribbon.

Money ran short, and the first phase stopped at Qilianshan Road, 15.9 km from Jiading, without joining the city streets. In its first two years it carried on average only 5,641 vehicles a day, fewer than the old Huyi road beside it. A second phase, begun in December 1991 and opened on 18 December 1993, brought it into the city.

It was extended to Liuhe in Taicang in 2000–2001 and renamed the Shanghai–Jiading–Liuhe Expressway, numbered A12. In 2006 the Liuhe end was transferred to the Jiajin Expressway and the road went back to its old name.
zh: 经过三年的立项研究，1984 年 12 月 14 日，上海市建委和市计委批准初步设计，同意按高速公路标准实施；12 月 21 日开工。1988 年 10 月 31 日通车，时任中共上海市委书记江泽民剪彩。
由于投资受限，一期只建到祁连山路，自嘉定起 15.9 公里，未与市区道路贯通。通车头两年，平均日交通量仅 5641 辆，比相邻的沪宜公路还低。二期于 1991 年 12 月开工，1993 年 12 月 18 日通车，把它接进了市区。
2000 至 2001 年，它延伸至太仓浏河，改称沪嘉浏高速公路，编号 A12。2006 年，浏河一端划归嘉金高速，这条路又改回沪嘉高速公路的名称。

en: The first phase cost about 230 million yuan. Most of it came from road maintenance fees, the levy then charged on vehicles for road upkeep; the Ministry of Communications added a 33 million yuan subsidy, with 5 million borrowed and 7 million from local government. The second phase, 211 million yuan, was paid entirely from maintenance fees.

Tolls came under pressure as the city grew around the road. From 15 March 2009 buses with more than 19 seats went free and cars paid 5 yuan; queues formed even off-peak. On 1 January 2012 tolls ended altogether, and on 4 January 2018 Shanghai government decree No. 64 ended the road's franchise and put it under city management.
zh: 一期工程总投资约 2.3 亿元，大部分来自公路养路费——当时向车辆征收的道路养护费用；交通部补助 3300 万元，另有贷款 500 万元、地方财政拨款 700 万元。二期工程总投资 2.11 亿元，全部由养路费支出。
随着城市向道路四周扩张，收费压力越来越大。2009 年 3 月 15 日起实行「弹性收费」：19 座以上客车免费，小客车每车次 5 元；即便如此，非高峰时段也出现排队。2012 年 1 月 1 日起完全停止收费；2018 年 1 月 4 日，上海市人民政府第 64 号令废止其专营性质，转由市政府管理。

value.en: About 230 million yuan for the 1984–1988 first phase (another account gives 228 million); 211 million for the 1991–1993 second phase

figures.source: Shanghai Society of Civil Engineering, 沪嘉高速公路（1988年）, 15 August 2013; 李家东, 大陆首条高速公路建设曲折历程, Shanghai Party History (ccphistory.org.cn), 2018

value.en: First phase: Ministry of Communications subsidy 33 million yuan, loans 5 million, local government 7 million, the rest from Shanghai road maintenance fees. Second phase: wholly from maintenance fees. The first-phase split is from secondary sources and has not been checked against the Shanghai gazetteer.
value.zh: 一期：交通部补助 3300 万元，贷款 500 万元，地方财政拨款 700 万元，其余由公路养路费列支。二期：全部由养路费支出。一期分项出自二手资料，尚未与上海地方志核对。

figures.source: 江苏财经 (jscj.net), 高速公路免费没有时间表, 2012; 钢之家百科, 沪嘉高速公路; 李家东, Shanghai Party History, 2018

value.en: 18.65 km today; 15.9 km of main line plus 4.6 km of approaches when the first phase was designed
value.zh: 现全长 18.65 公里；一期设计时主线 15.9 公里，两端引道 4.6 公里

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 沪嘉高速公路; 李家东, Shanghai Party History, 2018

label.en: Traffic in the first two years

value.en: 5,641 vehicles a day on average, against a design capacity of 38,000
value.zh: 平均日交通量 5641 辆，设计昼夜交通量 3.8 万辆

figures.source: 李家东, Shanghai Party History, 2018; Shanghai Society of Civil Engineering, 2013

timeline.en: Work begins on 21 December, a week after the design is approved to expressway standard.
timeline.zh: 12 月 21 日开工，距按高速公路标准批准初步设计仅一周。

timeline.en: The first phase opens on 31 October — the first expressway on the Chinese mainland.
timeline.zh: 10 月 31 日一期通车——中国大陆第一条高速公路。

timeline.en: Work begins in December on the second phase into the city.
timeline.zh: 12 月，延伸入市区的二期工程开工。

timeline.en: The second phase opens on 18 December.
The extension to Liuhe opens on 20 December; the road becomes the Shanghai–Jiading–Liuhe Expressway.
timeline.zh: 12 月 20 日，延伸至浏河段通车，改称沪嘉浏高速公路。

timeline.en: The Liuhe end passes to the Jiajin Expressway and the old name returns.
timeline.zh: 浏河一端划归嘉金高速，恢复沪嘉高速原名。

timeline.en: Partial toll exemption begins on 15 March.
timeline.zh: 3 月 15 日起实行弹性收费。

timeline.en: Tolls end on 1 January; rebuilding as a six-lane urban expressway begins.
timeline.zh: 1 月 1 日起完全停止收费；按六车道城市快速路标准改造开工。

timeline.en: The second stage of the rebuild is completed in February.
Decree No. 64 of 4 January ends the road's franchise.
timeline.zh: 1 月 4 日，市政府第 64 号令废止其专营性质。

timeline.en: Work starts on 30 August on raising 9.6 km onto a viaduct.
timeline.zh: 8 月 30 日起，9.6 公里路段开始高架化改造。
